introduction.zh: 你在普通讨论中更想先了解可能、整体走向、体验、落实、结构、实际用处、共同情绪，还是具体关系？24条原创题把这些信息组成四个经典quadra相关配对，呈现四组原始计数与全部最高并列报告。四份完整说明分别介绍受重视元素、所属四个TIM、具体例子和其他三组对照。它是框架反思，不测功能强弱、八个位置或你的16型，也不由组别决定职业、关系或成长方向。
introduction.en: In an ordinary discussion, what would you rather understand first: possibilities, a trajectory, experience, immediate action, structure, usefulness, shared feelings or personal relations? Twenty-four original items organise information pairs around four classical quadras and present raw counts with every highest-count full guide. Each guide explains valued elements, four TIM members, examples and three comparisons. This is framework reflection rather than a measure of function strengths, eight positions or your individual TIM, with no career, compatibility or growth prescription.

instructions.zh: 把每题当作普通、条件允许且没有必须按某一种做的情境，选你此刻更愿意先了解或展开的一组信息，不选自己最擅长、最应该或别人期望的答案。24条原创四选一各给一个quadra计1次，四组都出现24次且每个位置各6次，合计24。四个quadra来自经典Socionics的受重视信息元素组合；题目中的配对与加法规则是本站编辑方法，不测八个功能强弱或Model A位置。全部最高计数并列都保留，完整说明介绍每组四个TIM，但不由这份选择鉴定你的16型、MBTI、关系相容性、健康或职业。可以随时退出，不必为保持一致选同类。
instructions.en: Treat each item as an ordinary feasible situation with no required approach. Choose the information pair you would currently rather understand or explore first, rather than what you do best, ought to do or think others expect. Each of 24 original four-choice items adds one count to one quadra. Each group appears 24 times and six times in each position, with 24 counts overall. The four quadras refer to classical Socionics valued information-element sets. The pairings and additive mapping are editorial conventions, not measurements of eight function strengths or Model A positions. Keep every highest-count tie. Full guides explain the four TIMs in each group without identifying your 16-type, converting MBTI or predicting compatibility, health or careers. You may exit and need not force consistency across choices.

label.zh: 此刻谁愿意明确推动一步，以及共同情绪怎样表达。

label.en: Other possible situations for it and how it could be applied there.

prompt.zh: 同伴介绍一项普通兴趣计划，你更想接着问哪一组内容？

label.zh: 还可能有什么有趣变化，以及哪些想法最能带起共同兴致。

label.zh: 怎样改善实际使用感受，以及哪种改法已经显示有用。

label.zh: 必须明确指出哪些当下边界，以及规定之间是否有清楚层次。

prompt.en: During an ordinary shared activity, which pair would you rather understand first?

label.zh: 大家当下是否自在，以及怎样表达共同的轻松或兴奋。

label.zh: 它最后想说明什么整体含义，以及怎样用一个框架表达。

label.zh: 它接下来可能走向哪里，以及怎样查验实际价值。

label.zh: 还有什么新的用法，以及各用法怎样实际试出来。

label.zh: 还有哪些可选方向，以及各方向怎样照顾具体的人际意愿。

label.zh: 调整又打开了哪些可能，以及大家对这些可能怎样表达兴致。

label.zh: 参与体验中哪些细节舒服，以及共同情绪怎样流动。

label.zh: 哪些实际边界需要明确，以及不同使用情境按什么规则区分。

label.zh: 哪些当下界限需要说清落实，以及每个人愿意怎样来往。

title.zh: 这份组别结果在描述什么

paragraphs.zh: Alpha 是经典Socionics四个quadra之一。这里的结果表示，你在这24道题中较多选择了本站映射到Alpha信息配对的选项；它不是“你天生是某种人”。本版关注更愿意先展开哪些信息，既没有测信息处理能力，也没有观察真实社交表现。最高计数可与其他组并列，届时每份完整说明都应一起读，不必从中再选一个真正身份。
paragraphs.en: Alpha is one of four quadras in classical Socionics. This result means that more of your choices in these 24 items followed the website’s editorial Alpha information-pair mapping. It does not establish an inborn identity. The reflection concerns which information you would rather explore first, without measuring processing ability or observing social performance. Highest counts may tie; read every matched full guide without selecting a single true identity afterwards.

paragraphs.zh: 在本版采用的经典集合中，Alpha共同重视Ne、Si、Fe、Ti。Ne关注可能与潜能，Si关注体验的顺适与细节，Fe关注情绪表达与共同气氛，Ti关注一致性与结构。本题用这些元素的配对组织选择，但没有单独测出八项功能强弱；选择一次某配对，也不证明你平时总先用其中任何一个。框架中的“重视”不是道德更高或技能更强。
paragraphs.en: The classical valued set used here contains Ne, Si, Fe and Ti. Ne concerns possibilities and potential, Si the quality and flow of experience, Fe expressed feeling and shared mood, and Ti consistency and structure. Items organise editorial pairs of these elements rather than measure eight separate function strengths. Selecting one pair does not prove a habitual processing order. Valuing an element within the framework establishes neither moral superiority nor greater skill.

title.en: Four TIM members and positional differences

paragraphs.zh: 这一组的四个TIM是ILE、SEI、ESE、LII。按所核Model A资料，它们的前两个元素分别为ILE的Ne—Ti、SEI的Si—Fe、ESE的Fe—Si、LII的Ti—Ne。共享一组受重视元素不等于八个位置相同，也不表示四种TIM是同一类型。本次计数没有判断你属于其中哪一个，没有补出完整Model A，更不把三字母代码换成MBTI四字母。
paragraphs.en: The four TIM members are ILE, SEI, ESE and LII. In the checked Model A account, their first two elements are Ne–Ti for ILE, Si–Fe for SEI, Fe–Si for ESE and Ti–Ne for LII. A shared valued set does not make all eight positions identical or collapse four TIMs into one type. These counts select none of the four, supply no complete Model A and convert no three-letter code into MBTI.

title.zh: 一个具体信息选择情境

paragraphs.zh: 例如，大家在整理兴趣活动材料，你更想先讨论几种可能的分类，再看看分类理由是否前后一致；另一次，你更想调整浏览体验，并让每个人表达当下感受。它们分别是本版Alpha配对的两个例子，不代表其他组不会这样做。任务确有固定格式时，应先按实际要求处理，不能为了符合Alpha而增加点子或改变别人安排。
paragraphs.en: For example, while organising interest materials, you may first want alternative categories and a check of their internal consistency. On another occasion, you may prefer refining the browsing experience while giving people room to express current feelings. These illustrate two Alpha pairings in this edition rather than behaviours unavailable to other groups. Actual format requirements still apply; there is no reason to add ideas or change another person’s arrangement to fit Alpha.

paragraphs.zh: 一句表达可以是：“我想先看两种分类可能，再确认解释是否一致；也想知道大家用起来是否舒服。”这在说明希望讨论的信息，不是要求共同任务永远轻松、开放或没有边界。你可以再问同伴此刻最缺什么信息，并接受先后顺序需要协商。称自己为Alpha并不能替代明确请求，也不让别人负有维持某种气氛的义务。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I would like to compare two possible categories, check that the explanation is consistent and hear whether using them feels comfortable.” This names information you want rather than requiring every task to stay relaxed, open or without boundaries. Ask what information others need now and negotiate the sequence. An Alpha label replaces no concrete request and gives nobody a duty to maintain your preferred atmosphere.

paragraphs.en: Compared with Beta, the classical sets share Fe and Ti, differing between Alpha’s Ne/Si and Beta’s Se/Ni. Compared with Delta, they share Ne and Si, differing between Fe/Ti and Te/Fi. Gamma’s valued set does not overlap Alpha’s, but actual people need not lack common ground, conflict or require lessons from an opposite group. These are set comparisons rather than relationship predictions; all three other full guides remain available.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，一个人可能在当前材料里选择开放分类，在另一项有明确限制的事情里更想直接落实步骤。计数较低也不表示缺少好奇、舒适、情绪或逻辑。四组在理论中都涉及全部八个元素，只是安排与重视集合不同；本题更没有直接观察它们。结果不评公平、温暖、创造力、智商、职业、健康、政治观或与谁相处最好。
paragraphs.en: Someone may choose open categories for the current material and prefer definite steps in another activity with clear constraints. A lower tally establishes no absence of curiosity, comfort, feeling or logic. In the theory, every type includes all eight elements with different arrangements and valued sets; this reflection does not directly observe those processes. Results assess no fairness, warmth, creativity, IQ, career, health, political view or best relationship partner.

paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, recall an ordinary information discussion. Separate what you wanted to understand first, what the task actually required and what others proposed. Recollection is enough; nobody needs to reorganise an activity or change. In a suitable small task, you could ask whether another classification is welcome before considering its usefulness. paragraphs.en: Beta is the second quadra in classical Socionics. More Beta-mapped choices here mean only that its editorial information pairs were selected more often within these 24 items, without certifying assertiveness, charisma or a mission. You may simply want a clearer direction and structure for an ordinary arrangement; actual action is unobserved. Keep every highest-count tie with full guides, without using order or a small difference to divide people into categories.

paragraphs.en: The Beta valued set used here contains Se, Ni, Fe and Ti. Se concerns immediate impact and definite boundaries, Ni significance and a longer trajectory, Fe shared emotional expression, and Ti consistent structure. Items pair one perceiving element with one judging element as an editorial method of organising options. paragraphs.en: The TIM members are SLE, IEI, EIE and LSI. The checked Model A account gives first two elements of Se–Ti for SLE, Ni–Fe for IEI, Fe–Ni for EIE and Ti–Se for LSI. paragraphs.zh: 例如，准备一个普通展示区域时，你更希望先说清现场哪些界限要落实，以及分区依据是什么；讨论兴趣分享时，你又想先知道整体走向和希望表达的共同感受。两种配对都映射Beta，但不证明你会指挥别人或喜欢冲突。具体安排应以实际职责、共同约定与可行条件为准，不根据quadra名称来分配谁发号施令。
paragraphs.en: For an ordinary display area, you may first want definite boundaries and the rules distinguishing sections. For an interest-sharing session, you may instead want its overall direction and the shared feeling people wish to express. Both pairs map to Beta here, without proving a desire to command or engage in conflict. Actual duties, agreements and feasible conditions govern the arrangement rather than a quadra deciding who gives orders.

paragraphs.zh: 一句表达可以是：“先确认我们要表达的整体方向，再说清哪些现场安排需要明确决定。”这可以只是一次讨论顺序，不表示你有权替所有人决定。可以询问哪些部分已有真实要求、哪些仍可共同商量，并听取对方需要的信息。若他人想先探索更多可能，也不必用Beta和其他组给彼此贴标签；具体差异比名称更容易协商。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “Let us clarify the overall direction we want to express, then identify which immediate arrangements need a definite decision.” That proposes a discussion sequence rather than authority over everyone. Ask what requirements already exist and what remains negotiable, listening to information others need. If someone prefers exploring alternatives first, describe the concrete difference rather than assign Beta and another group as explanations for both people.

paragraphs.zh: Beta与Alpha共享Fe、Ti，区别在Se、Ni与Ne、Si；与Gamma共享Se、Ni，区别在Fe、Ti与Te、Fi。Delta的受重视集合与Beta不重叠，但不能据此预测不相容、冲突或指定Delta为必需成长方向。各组在理论里仍处理全部八种信息，计数不反映人际价值。可以逐组比较自己偏向哪些题目里的信息，而不是比较谁更有领导力或更可靠。
paragraphs.en: Beta shares Fe/Ti with Alpha, differing between Se/Ni and Ne/Si. It shares Se/Ni with Gamma, differing between Fe/Ti and Te/Fi. Delta’s valued set does not overlap Beta’s, without predicting incompatibility or prescribing Delta as a necessary growth direction. Every type still includes all eight elements in the theory. Compare specific information choices across all four guides rather than rank leadership, reliability or personal worth.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，某次任务确实需要当场划定范围或共同表达目标，任何人都可能选择相应信息；另一次你可能只想让流程顺手。计数不表明你重视权力、集体主义、英雄叙事或政治立场，也不证明你能调动群体情绪。理论机构或竞品提出的健康、职业、相容性与社会预测，不会因本测试用了同样的四组名称就得到本站验证。
paragraphs.en: An actual task may require immediate boundaries or an expressed shared goal, leading anyone to choose that information; another occasion may favour ease of use. Counts establish no preference for power, collectivism, heroic narratives or political positions and no ability to influence a group. Health, career, compatibility or societal predictions made elsewhere acquire no website validation merely because this reflection uses the same quadra names.

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：回想一件普通安排，列出自己当时更想明确的方向、规则或行动，以及别人需要的补充信息。可以只回忆，不必主持讨论、挑战界限或加快活动。若某项规则尚未说清，可以在适合时问一句，而不是直接替别人决定。观察在于把偏好落到具体内容，允许保留其他选择，不训练强势或“变成Beta”。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, recall an ordinary arrangement. Note the direction, rule or action you wanted to clarify and information others needed. Recollection requires no leading, boundary challenge or acceleration of the activity. If a rule remains unclear, ask when appropriate rather than decide for others. Ground a preference in concrete information while allowing other choices, without practising dominance or trying to become Beta.

title.zh: 这份组别结果在描述什么

paragraphs.zh: Gamma 是经典Socionics的第三个quadra。较多Gamma计数，表示你在本组原创题里较多优先选择了相应信息配对，不表示更现实、更冷静或比别人更有效率。题目问想先了解什么，没有观察你做得怎样。若多个组同为最高，保留各份完整说明即可，不用用一个最像自己的词消除并列，也不把其他较低计数解释成能力缺口。
paragraphs.en: Gamma is the third quadra in classical Socionics. More Gamma-mapped choices here indicate more frequent selection of its editorial information pairs, without establishing greater realism, calmness or efficiency than others. Items ask what you want to understand first, not how well you perform. Keep every highest-count guide when groups tie. There is no need to erase a tie with a self-description or turn lower counts into ability deficits.

paragraphs.zh: 本版采用的Gamma受重视集合是Se、Ni、Te、Fi。Se关注眼前影响与边界的落实，Ni关注较长过程的走向与意义，Te关注实际怎样运作和查验用处，Fi关注具体的人际态度与关系距离。配对选项并没有把四项分开计分，也不测预见未来、赚钱、读心或判断谁真诚；它们只是理论术语在普通信息讨论中的原创表达。
paragraphs.en: The Gamma valued set used here contains Se, Ni, Te and Fi. Se concerns immediate impact and definite boundaries, Ni a longer trajectory and significance, Te practical operation and checking usefulness, and Fi particular relational attitudes and distance. paragraphs.en: The four TIM members are SEE, ILI, LIE and ESI. Their first two elements in the checked Model A account are Se–Fi for SEE, Ni–Te for ILI, Te–Ni for LIE and Fi–Se for ESI. title.zh: 一个具体信息选择情境

paragraphs.zh: 例如，比较两份兴趣材料时，你更希望先了解每份会把后续学习带向哪里，以及怎样检查实际用处；共同安排一个小区域时，你又更关心哪些边界当下要落实、具体参与者愿意怎样来往。这是本版两个Gamma配对例子，不证明你追逐利益或只重结果。若任务本来已有硬性要求，先按事实判断，不因组别而默认某种做法更适合你。
paragraphs.en: When comparing interest materials, you may want their likely learning trajectory and a way to check practical usefulness. For a small shared area, you may prefer definite immediate boundaries and information about how particular people wish to relate. These illustrate two Gamma pairings here rather than prove self-interest or an exclusive focus on outcomes. Actual requirements govern a task; a group label cannot establish which approach suits you best.

paragraphs.zh: 一句表达可以是：“我想知道这个做法后续怎样运作，以及我们按什么实际信息判断有用；个人参与的边界也想说清。”它把信息请求说具体，并不让你有权替别人评估关系或价值。可以问同伴还希望先讨论哪些可能或共同感受。不同优先顺序可以协商，不能把自己称为Gamma当成不必解释、不能被质疑或必须高效的理由。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want to understand how this approach works over time, what information checks its usefulness and the boundaries of personal participation.” That specifies a request rather than authority to evaluate somebody else’s relationship or worth. Ask whether others need alternatives or shared feelings discussed first. Different priorities are negotiable; Gamma creates no entitlement to avoid explanation, resist questions or demand efficiency.

paragraphs.zh: Gamma与Beta共享Se、Ni，差别在Te、Fi与Fe、Ti；与Delta共享Te、Fi，差别在Se、Ni与Ne、Si。Alpha的受重视集合与Gamma不重叠，但不能推断两人必然相斥，也不指定Alpha为你缺少的成长方向。集合对照说明的是框架关系，实际的人仍有共同经历、能力和选择；本次计数没有测出这些，也不能用较低组别替别人排序。
paragraphs.en: Gamma shares Se/Ni with Beta, differing between Te/Fi and Fe/Ti. It shares Te/Fi with Delta, differing between Se/Ni and Ne/Si. paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, revisit an ordinary proposal discussion. Separate practical information you wanted to check, the trajectory you wanted to understand and personal boundaries involved. Recollection requires no extra output, negotiation or relationship change. If discussion is welcome, ask one genuinely unanswered question and allow information to remain incomplete. Ground an information need rather than practise calculation, raise Gamma counts or suppress other choices.

title.zh: 这份组别结果在描述什么

paragraphs.zh: Delta 是经典Socionics的第四个quadra，中文在这里写作德尔塔，而不是把英文名称当地理上的三角洲。较多Delta计数，只表示本组题里相应信息配对较常被选中；不认证安稳、耐心、谦逊或某种生活理想。其他组最高并列时，每份报告都完整保留，不用认为四种人只能选一类，也不把名次顺序看成个人人格比例。
paragraphs.en: Delta is the fourth quadra in classical Socionics; its name here refers to the theoretical group, not a geographical river delta. paragraphs.en: Delta shares Ne/Si with Alpha, differing between Te/Fi and Fe/Ti. It shares Te/Fi with Gamma, differing between Ne/Si and Se/Ni. paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, recall an ordinary arrangement. question.zh: Socionics在这里指什么，会得到16型吗？
question.en: What does Socionics mean here, and will I receive an individual TIM?

answer.zh: Socionics在这里指社会人格学这一类型框架，不是一般社交心理学。经典资料以八种信息元素和Model A的八个位置描述16个TIM，并将它们分为Alpha、Beta、Gamma、Delta四个quadra；共享受重视集合不等于位置相同。本版只探索原创选项里四组信息配对的选择倾向，完整说明列出各组四个TIM与前两元素，不鉴定你属于哪一个。所有类型在理论中都包含八个元素，低计数不等于某种功能缺失；组别也不转换成MBTI。
answer.en: Socionics here names a typological framework rather than social psychology generally. Classical accounts describe sixteen TIMs using eight information elements in eight Model A positions and group them into Alpha, Beta, Gamma and Delta quadras. A shared valued set does not imply identical positions. This edition explores choices among four editorial information-pair clusters and explains each group’s four TIM members and first two elements without identifying your individual TIM. Every type includes eight elements in the theory; low counts establish no missing function and groups provide no MBTI conversion.

question.zh: 四个quadra各有哪些信息元素与TIM？
question.en: Which valued elements and TIMs belong to each quadra?

answer.zh: Alpha重视Ne、Si、Fe、Ti，成员ILE、SEI、ESE、LII；Beta为Se、Ni、Fe、Ti，成员SLE、IEI、EIE、LSI；Gamma为Se、Ni、Te、Fi，成员SEE、ILI、LIE、ESI；Delta为Ne、Si、Te、Fi，成员IEE、SLI、LSE、EII。这些是所选经典框架的分组关系，不是本测试鉴定出的16种个人结果；四份完整正文解释位置差别和三组对照。
answer.en: Alpha values Ne/Si/Fe/Ti and includes ILE, SEI, ESE and LII. Beta values Se/Ni/Fe/Ti and includes SLE, IEI, EIE and LSI. Gamma values Se/Ni/Te/Fi and includes SEE, ILI, LIE and ESI. Delta values Ne/Si/Te/Fi and includes IEE, SLI, LSE and EII. These memberships belong to the selected classical account rather than sixteen identified personal results. Four full guides explain positions and comparisons.

question.zh: 怎样计分，最高并列会怎样？
question.en: How are counts and highest ties handled?

answer.zh: 每道原创题的所选项给对应quadra加1，共24次。四组都在24题中出现，每个位置各6次；分母24是选项出现次数，不是相似度。全部24题选择后显示四组原始计数，所有最高并列均完整保留，不按顺序、随机或强行主副型消除并列。低计数不等于没有某种信息功能，差1次不代表显著、真实类型改变或人群排名。没有常模、百分位、置信区间或本站心理测量验证；它也不测八项功能的强弱、位置和16个TIM。
answer.en: Each selected option adds one raw count to its mapped quadra, across 24 original items. Each group appears in all 24 items and six times in every position. A denominator of 24 counts appearances, not similarity. Complete all items for four tallies and every highest-count full guide, without ordering, randomness or forced primary/secondary labels breaking ties. Low counts establish no absent function; one extra choice establishes neither significance, a true type change nor a population rank. There are no norms, percentiles, confidence intervals or local psychometric validation. The reflection measures no eight function strengths or positions and identifies no individual TIM.

question.zh: 这份问卷是标准或验证过的Socionics工具吗？
question.en: Is this a standard or validated Socionics instrument?

answer.zh: 本版24条双语信息配对题、映射、计数与解释由费马原创，借经典Socionics四个quadra的受重视信息集合组织反思；四家族各6题、共16种配对是本站编辑方法。它不是标准Socionics题本或Model A鉴定，不采用竞品12题、正文、算法或其他受保护bank、键与常模。理论机构提供框架定义与类型所属关系，不验证本题、读法或跨语言等价。四组说明中的16个TIM及前两元素只是所选经典资料的教育性介绍，不是对你的类型判定。结果不评实际能力、功能强弱、脑部或生理状态、健康、政治或民族特征、道德、领导、绩效、聘用、职业、伴侣或关系相容性，也不把相反quadra指定为成长处方。它与MBTI没有一一换算；现实决定仍需事实、双方意愿与实际条件。
answer.en: FermatMind authored these 24 bilingual information-pair items, mappings, counts and explanations, organising reflection around valued sets in classical Socionics. Four families of six items and sixteen pairings are editorial conventions. This is no standard Socionics bank or Model A assessment and adopts no competitor items, body or algorithm, nor another protected bank, key or norms. Theory proponents supply definitions and memberships, not validation of these items, readings or language equivalence. The sixteen TIMs and their first two elements are educational descriptions of the selected classical account rather than your identified type. Results assess no ability, function strength, brain or bodily state, health, politics, ethnicity, morality, leadership, performance, hiring, career, partner or compatibility and prescribe no opposite-quadra growth path. There is no one-to-one MBTI conversion; actual decisions require facts, mutual wishes and real conditions.

question.zh: quadra能判断关系、职业或成长方向吗？
question.en: Can a quadra decide compatibility, careers or a growth direction?

answer.zh: 本版不能。受重视信息集合不同不证明实际的人会冲突或相容，同组也不保证沟通与能力。它不指定相反quadra为需要发展的方向，不推断职业、健康、政治或民族特征。正文只用普通具体信息讨论、表达、反例与可选观察帮助理解计数，实际决定仍看事实和双方意愿。
answer.en: Not in this edition. Different valued sets establish no conflict or compatibility between actual people, and shared membership guarantees no communication or ability. No opposite quadra is prescribed as a growth direction, and career, health, politics and ethnicity are unmeasured. Guides use ordinary information discussions, wording, counterexamples and optional observations; actual decisions require facts and mutual wishes.

question.zh: 完整结果、重测与分享免费吗？
